frequency_question: How often do such programs scale up their target operational volumes past initial phase-in caps rather than tapering or capping them?
membership_rule: Includes formalized, recurring central bank or treasury debt repurchase programs designed for liquidity or yield curve management in G7 economies since 2008. Excludes one-off emergency interventions.

Reserve Bank of Australia Bond Purchase Program

multiplier: 1 out of 3 scaled past initial operational constraints into sustained higher-volume execution.
